summary: Frontend-only SEO/image-optimization validation for Veracity Technologies. Verified: (1) no broken images across 9 representative pages (homepage, service, AI, resources index, blog post, 6 city pages, industry page) - all imgs completed with naturalWidth>0, no image request 404s captured; (2) lazy loading correctly applied - homepage has 38 images: 37 lazy + 1 eager (the top nav logo, correct by design), all other pages surveyed had 100% lazy images; (3) Service JSON-LD schema present on all 5 sampled city pages (bloomington-mn, minneapolis-mn, st-paul-mn, edina-mn, eden-prairie-mn, st-cloud-mn, wayzata-mn) with correct fields: name='Managed IT Services in <City>, MN', 4-item serviceType array, areaServed with GeoCoordinates, provider referencing #organization; JSON parses without errors, LocalBusiness+Service+BreadcrumbList+FAQPage all emitted (4 schemas total as expected); (4) og-image.jpg served on homepage, /resources, and pages that fall back to the site default; page-type-specific pages (services, AI, blog post, industry, city) supply their own custom og:image (webp hero or Unsplash URL) which is by design and NOT a regression of the .png->.jpg rename; homepage OG confirmed 'https://www.veracitytechmn.com/og-image.jpg'; (5) no new console errors observed, no image 404s on any tested route. Regression clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): Non-homepage page types (ServicePage, AIPage, BlogPost, IndustryPage, ServiceAreaPage) set og:image to their own hero image (relative /images/*.webp or external Unsplash URL) rather than the renamed og-image.jpg. This is expected behavior (pages with their own imagery override the site default). However two follow-ups may be worth considering: (a) social crawlers prefer absolute URLs - the '/images/xxx.webp' og:image values on service/AI/blog pages are relative paths and some scrapers (LinkedIn, older Slack) may fail to resolve them; consider prefixing with the canonical origin. (b) WebP is not universally supported by social preview crawlers - Facebook/LinkedIn/Twitter previews typically require JPG or PNG; the .webp og:image values on service, AI, and blog pages may render as blank previews on those platforms. Recommend keeping .jpg fallback or generating a companion .jpg per hero.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration validated image self-hosting/lazy-loading + Service schema on city pages + og-image rename. All passed. Notable: the correct slug for Saint Paul is 'st-paul-mn' (NOT 'saint-paul-mn' as the review request had it). If future tests target that URL, use st-paul-mn. Also: service/AI/blog/industry/city pages override og:image with page-specific imagery (some webp, some Unsplash), so 'og-image.jpg' only appears on pages using the site default (homepage, /resources, and other pages without a custom hero).
